review.notes: Full review of an unchanged head. Recomputed: KO table and J-gamma signs, all 64 real-product sign pairs, swap phases, orientation dictionary, circle and torus Weyl and Dixmier constants, noncommutative-torus cycle. All 40 cited Tau Ceti declarations and the Mathlib ones opened at the pins; cross-roadmap citations resolved on main. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with two sorry warnings, both signatures keep all binders, one-tactic probe fails on both. The previous review's four small corrections and two format notes stand (same commit); one question on the zigzag sign of 9.2.
